name: sli-phaseout-single
description: Student loan interest deduction phase-out at the exact midpoint of the band: single filer, MAGI $92,500, $2,500 interest paid. The deduction is half of $2,500 because $7,500 of MAGI over the $85,000 start is exactly half the $15,000 phase-out band - the one point in the band where the worksheet's 'rounded to at least three places' instruction is unambiguous (0.500 exactly).

source.publication: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025), Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet - Schedule 1, Line 21; Publication 970 (2025)
source.pin: Worksheet verbatim: line 1 'Don't enter more than $2,500'; line 5 'Single, head of household, or qualifying surviving spouse - $85,000'; line 7 'Divide line 6 by $15,000 ($30,000 if married filing jointly). Enter the result as a decimal (rounded to at least three places). If the result is 1.000 or more, enter 1.000'; line 8 'Multiply line 1 by line 7'; line 9 = line 1 - line 8. Excess $7,500 / $15,000 = 0.500 exactly - no rounding ambiguity at any decimal precision.

derivation: Wages $92,500 (MAGI before the deduction itself); interest paid $2,500 (the line-1 cap).
